SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.devNotice: Local test logins. They only work in development and are refused on Vercel.

NoAccess.title: No access yet
NoAccess.body: Your account doesn't have a role yet. Ask your admin to give you access.

nextSlot.title: Next publish slot
nextSlot.off: Auto-publish is off. Nothing goes out until someone presses Publish now.

reasons.gap: waiting for the gap between posts

connections.title: Connections
connections.askAdmin: Ask your admin to fix this.

Errors.engineUnreachable: The content engine can't be reached right now. Try again shortly.
Errors.engineInvalid: The content engine sent data in an unexpected format. Contact Quantum1st if this continues.
Errors.engineBusy: The content engine is busy. Your request is queued; try again shortly.
Errors.notFound: This item was removed. Go back to the list.

Review.title: Review
Review.publishSelectedBody: Each one is approved and published right away. Posts that need a reason or a photo are skipped and listed.

Editor.addKeyword: Add a keyword and press Enter
Editor.hashtagsHint: Press Enter to add. Spaces and commas separate hashtags.
Editor.lockedBy: Being edited by {name}. You can read it, or take over to edit.
Editor.conflictBody: They saved these fields differently. Keep mine saves your changes on top of their version; fields you didn't change keep theirs.
Editor.humanHint: Check these yourself; they're never marked as passed.
Editor.approveBlockedHint: A critical check can't be overridden here. Fix it first (see Checks).
Editor.overrideBody: This post has critical findings. Approving it anyway needs a reason, which is recorded in History.
Editor.changesBody: Say what should change. The post is redrafted and comes back for review.
Editor.rejectBody: It leaves the review queue. You can add a note.
Editor.compare: Side by side with the {language} version
Editor.structureMismatchOne: 1 section doesn't line up. TranslatePress needs both versions to have the same structure.
Editor.structureMismatchMany: {count} sections don't line up. TranslatePress needs both versions to have the same structure.
Editor.bodyUnsupported: The body contains content the editor can't keep ({elements}), so it's read-only here and will be saved exactly as it is. The other fields can still be edited.

photo.title: Photo
photo.required: Instagram posts need a photo before they can be approved or published.
photo.pickerBody: Search, then choose a photo. Its credit is saved with it.
photo.noResults: No photos found. Try other words.
photo.tooLarge: This file is {size} MB; the limit is {limit} MB.

Editor.publishBody: It goes live right away. Publishing now doesn't use up today's allowance.
Editor.publishBodyPending: This approves the post and publishes it right away.
Editor.publishNeedsApproval: Approve it with a reason first; then it can be published.
Editor.photoNeeded: Add a photo first: Instagram posts can't be approved or published without one.

Scheduled.title: Scheduled
Scheduled.publishBody: It goes live right away. Publishing now doesn't use up today's allowance.

Lists.skipped: {count, plural, one {{n} item couldn't be shown because the content engine sent it in an unexpected format.} other {{n} items couldn't be shown because the content engine sent them in an unexpected format.}}

History.title: History
History.empty: Nothing has been published, failed or been rejected yet.

ErrorPage.title: Something went wrong
ErrorPage.body: This page couldn't be shown. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact your admin.

Jobs.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to follow this job.

Quota.askAdmin: Ask your admin to raise the limit.
Quota.requested: Upgrade requested. Quantum1st will be in touch.
Quota.limitReachedAny: A monthly limit has been reached.

Keywords.title: Keywords
Keywords.draftBody: Each selected keyword gets its own article. Choose the language.
Keywords.draftsStarted: {count, plural, one {Drafting {n} article. It will appear in Review.} other {Drafting {n} articles. They will appear in Review.}}

add.title: Add keywords
add.hint: Separate them with commas or new lines.

propose.title: Propose keywords (AI)
propose.hint: The AI suggests keywords from the site's profile and searches.
propose.ready: New keywords are in the New tab.

Ideas.title: Topic ideas
Ideas.empty: No topic ideas yet. Propose topics from Keywords, or start a new request.
Ideas.draftBody: Choose the language. Both languages makes an English and an Arabic version that are linked.

request.title: New request
request.hint: Ask for an article or a social post on any topic.
request.keywordsHint: Separate them with commas. Leave empty and the engine proposes them.
request.started: {count, plural, one {Drafting {n} post. It will appear in Review.} other {Drafting {n} posts. They will appear in Review.}}

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.checkFields: Some fields need attention. See the messages under them.
Settings.testFirst: Test the connection first: a changed connection is saved only after its test passes.

conflict.title: Someone saved first
conflict.body: These settings changed while you were editing. Nothing is lost: compare the two versions and choose.

schedule.title: Publishing schedule
schedule.hint: When approved posts go out. The content engine works out the exact times.
schedule.autoPublishHint: When this is off, nothing goes out until someone presses Publish now.

seo.title: SEO profile
seo.hint: How the site presents itself, and the profile the AI writes from.
seo.profileHint: The AI follows this profile whenever it writes for the site.
seo.listHint: Separate with commas or new lines.
seo.propose: Suggest focus keywords and a call to action
seo.proposed: Suggestions filled in. Check them, then save.
seo.proposalUnreadable: The suggestions came back in a form the portal can't read. Nothing was changed.

picture.title: Share picture
picture.hint: Shown when an article is shared without its own photo. {types}, up to {size} MB.
picture.tooLarge: This file is {size} MB; the limit is {limit} MB.

website.title: Website connection
website.hint: Where approved articles are published. The fields come from the content engine.
website.secretKept: Saved. Leave it empty to keep it.
website.needsTest: Test the connection before saving: its type, address, user or password changed.
website.fieldMapHint: Which website field receives each part of the article. Test the connection to see the website's fields.
website.blockMapHint: Which block receives each part of the article's body.
website.mapEmpty: Nothing to map yet. Test the connection to get suggestions.

arabicModes.translatepress: TranslatePress translation of the English post
arabicModes.locale: Arabic locale of the same entry

social.title: Social accounts
social.hint: The accounts social posts are published to. Connecting opens the platform's own sign-in.
social.disconnectBody: Posts for {platform} can't be published until it's connected again.
social.unsafeAddress: The content engine sent a sign-in address the portal won't open. Contact Quantum1st.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.hint: The content engine tells this dashboard when drafts are ready, posts fail, connections break or quotas run low, so the right people get an email. Every delivery is signed; the signing secret is kept encrypted on this server.
webhook.noAddress: This dashboard's address couldn't be read from the request.

status.off: Not set up. Screens still update when you open them, but nobody gets emails.
status.elsewhere: Registered to another address: {url}. Setting it up here moves it, and that address stops getting deliveries.
status.secretMissing: Registered here, but this server can't read the signing secret, so deliveries are refused. Get a new secret.
status.connected: Set up. Deliveries to this address are checked against the signing secret.

webhook.rotateHint: A new secret replaces the old one straight away.
webhook.done: Webhook set up. Deliveries are now signed with the new secret.
webhook.notConfigured: This server can't store the signing secret: WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY isn't set.

NotConnected.message: {name} isn't connected, so this can't be published.
NotConnected.askAdmin: Ask your admin to connect it.

SiteHealth.title: Site health
SiteHealth.hint: Problems the content engine found on the website, and the fixes it proposes. Applying a fix changes the live website.
SiteHealth.applyTitle: Apply this fix to the live website?
SiteHealth.applyBody: The content engine will change {url} on the website now.

results.title: This site's results
results.liveUrls: See the live URLs in History

upgrade.title: Request an upgrade
upgrade.hint: Quantum1st sets the limits. Tell them what you need.
upgrade.requested: Upgrade requested. Quantum1st will be in touch.

Users.title: Users
Users.intro: Everyone who can sign in to this dashboard. Admins manage settings and users; Reviewers work on content.
Users.testNotice: Test logins: invitations are listed here, but no email is sent and they can't be accepted.
Users.selfHint: You can't change your own access.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.hint: They get an email from the sign-in service with a link to create their account, with this role.

errors.conflict: This person already has an account or an invitation.
errors.not_found: This person or invitation no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.unavailable: The sign-in service can't be reached right now. Try again shortly.
errors.self: You can't change your own access.
errors.network_error: The server could not be reached. Try again shortly.

Security.title: Two-factor login
Security.required: Your role is Admin, so two-factor login is required. Turn it on to continue: you'll enter a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in.
Security.recommended: Two-factor login is recommended: each time you sign in, you'll also enter a code from an authenticator app.
Security.testNotice: Test logins only: this switch stands in for setting up an authenticator app.
